# prove-it PF-2 rerun — BUILDER task spec (wave 2, orchestrated)

You are a supervised Orca worker. Obey the live preamble injected with this task
for all lifecycle mechanics (`check`, `ask`, `worker_done`). In particular: run
`orca orchestration check --terminal <your_handle>` at each checkpoint and once
more immediately before `worker_done`; send `worker_done` exactly once with an
explicit `--outcome succeeded|failed` (omit `--to` — the owning Run mailbox is
the address); every send carries `--from <your_handle> --dispatch-capability
<capability>` from the preamble; evidence rides typed flags (`--report-path`,
`--files-modified`), never a hand-rolled payload blob.

## Target
Repo orca-fleet, your worktree checkout (cwd). Run directory:
`docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/`. Test file: `tests/test_verify.py`.
Production seam: `runtime/scripts/verify.py::check_oracle_scope` (kind gate,
currently lines 988-989 — VERIFY before touching anything, see step 1).

## Change
Re-execute the PF-2 characterization wave for prove-it (roadmap #410):
re-derive the existing `OracleScopeKindTest` net from the FROZEN criterion (do
not trust it — verify each test binds), ADD the missing non-dict-scope
kind-gate test, prove the 4-test net with a full mutation audit, record fresh
evidence, commit, and push to the PR branch.

## Constraints (do-not-touch + invariants)
- The frozen criterion PF-2 is FIXED (run dir `contract.json`): "verify.py
  check_oracle_scope refuses an oracle_scope whose kind is neither
  characterization nor documentation, and admits both legal kinds past the
  kind gate." Same frozen set as wave 1 — no scope change.
- Touch ONLY: `tests/test_verify.py` (one new test method + at most a minimal
  class-docstring touch) and NEW files under the run dir (names below) plus
  `manifest.json` field updates (fields below). Every other file is read-only.
  NEVER edit: `contract.json`, solo-run artifacts (`tests.txt`,
  `negctrl.txt`, `audit-*.txt`, `audit-m1.diff`, `review.txt`,
  `verifier*.txt`, `validation.txt`, `tests-full.txt`), any `SKILL.md`,
  any playbook/runtime doc, production code (except transient in-memory
  mutant application during the audit, always reverted — verify with
  `git status` + `cmp` afterwards).
- NEVER hand-edit `manifest.json`'s `commands[]` — append ONLY via
  `runtime/scripts/evidence-run.py`. NEVER touch `contract`, `criteria`,
  `review`, `reviewer_mode`, `lighting`, `intent`, `base_sha` (coordinator-owned).
- Methodology pack: matt ONLY — read `/Users/ravindra/.agents/skills/tdd/SKILL.md`
  (seams + tautology guard + red-green) and the fleet playbooks
  `playbooks/characterize.md`, `playbooks/build-change.md`,
  `playbooks/design-twice.md` from your checkout. NEVER load any addy/gstack
  skill (no co-mount — one pack per worker).
- The seam is pre-agreed (design-twice §5): tests assert observable behavior
  at `check_oracle_scope(m, source, digest)`, never internals. Expected values
  are independent literals (the documented error strings), never recomputed.
- Characterization-of-existing-code honesty: the production gate already
  exists, so the new test is GREEN on clean code by construction. The honest
  RED is the mutation audit below — a test that stays GREEN under its
  criterion-violating mutant is a SURVIVOR and fails this task. Do not fake red.
- Git: author `Ravindra Kumar <ravidsrk@gmail.com>` on every commit, no
  trailers, no `git add -A` (stage only the unit's files), never force-push,
  never open a PR, never rebase anyone else's commits. No secrets in evidence.

## Ownership
Your unit branch in this worktree; the two commits below; the new run-dir
artifacts. The coordinator owns the contract coords, the review, the verifier
re-record, and the run report.

## Steps
1. Setup + guards: `git fetch origin`. Create your unit branch from the PR
   head: `git checkout -b prove-it-pf2-rerun-wt
   origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo` (if that branch already exists from a
   retry, inspect first — never reset away pushed work). `git status
   --porcelain` must be empty — otherwise STOP and `ask`. Confirm the kind
   gate is still exactly lines 988-989 (`grep -n "not isinstance(scope,
   dict)" runtime/scripts/verify.py`) — if it moved, STOP and `ask`.
2. Read: run-dir `contract.json` (the denominator), `manifest.json` (current
   shape only), `negctrl.txt` + `audit-m1.diff` (the wave-1 pinned mutant
   DEFINITION — you will re-derive it, not reuse its transcripts),
   `tests/test_verify.py::OracleScopeKindTest`, the three fleet playbooks and
   the matt `tdd` skill above.
3. Re-derive: for each of the 3 existing tests, confirm it asserts exactly one
   PF-2 half at/past the kind gate (error-string identity). Then ADD:
   `test_non_dict_scope_refused_at_kind_gate` — `self._contract(
   "characterization")` (a STRING scope, exercising the `not
   isinstance(scope, dict)` disjunct) asserting exactly `["oracle scope: kind
   must be characterization or documentation"]`.
4. GREEN: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_verify.OracleScopeKindTest` → 4/4 OK.
   Then `ruff check tests/test_verify.py` → clean.
5. Commit 1 (test only): `prove-it rerun: pin non-dict scope at the PF-2 kind
   gate (issue #410)`. Record its SHA as HEAD_TEST.
6. Record GREEN at the clean tree: from the clean tree at HEAD_TEST, run the
   criterion-bound command through the recorder (this appends the binding
   `commands[]` record whose wtree must equal HEAD_TEST's tree — verify that
   equality with `git rev-parse HEAD_TEST^{tree}`):
   `python3 runtime/scripts/evidence-run.py --label "tests rerun 2026-09-16
   (wave 2, 4-test net)" --manifest
   docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/manifest.json --artifact
   docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/tests-rerun.txt -- python3 -m unittest
   tests.test_verify.OracleScopeKindTest` → exit 0.
7. Mutation audit (fresh transcripts, same mutant family):
   - Re-derive m1: delete lines 988-989. `git diff` the result and compare to
     `audit-m1.diff` — it MUST be byte-identical (same hunk, modulo the index
     line). If the hunk differs, STOP and `ask`. Save the re-derived diff as
     `audit-m1-rerun.diff`.
   - Clean run → `audit-rerun-clean.txt` (4 tests OK, exit 0).
   - Apply m1 → `audit-rerun-m1-red.txt`. EXPECTED: exit 1, `FAILED
     (failures=1, errors=1)` — bogus-kind case FAILs with AssertionError at
     the PF-2 assertion (the kill), non-dict case ERRORs with AttributeError
     (without the gate a string scope crashes at gate 5 instead of being
     refused — record this honestly as error-not-failure), the two legal-kind
     cases still pass. REQUIRED for KILLED: failures>=1 AND `AssertionError`
     present in the output. If failures==0, the net is broken — STOP and `ask`.
   - Revert (`git checkout -- runtime/scripts/verify.py`, `cmp` against a
     pristine copy) → `audit-rerun-reverted.txt` (4 tests OK, exit 0).
   - m2 (`not in`→`in` on line 988): expect FAILED (failures=3) — non-dict
     case still passes (m2 leaves the isinstance disjunct intact; record that)
     → `audit-rerun-m2-red.txt`, revert.
   - m3 (tuple→`("documentation",)`): expect FAILED (failures=1) →
     `audit-rerun-m3-red.txt`, revert.
   - m4 (tuple→`("characterization",)`): expect FAILED (failures=1) →
     `audit-rerun-m4-red.txt`, revert. Final `git status` clean of production
     edits (only the new run-dir files + manifest + test commit).
   - Write `negctrl-rerun.txt`: same shape as `negctrl.txt` (pinned-mutant
     narrative + the re-derived diff + control transcripts + supporting-mutant
     lines + verdict), with ACTUAL outputs, never wave-1's.
   - RE-MAP: `uvx coverage run --source=runtime/scripts -m unittest
     tests.test_verify.OracleScopeKindTest` + `uvx coverage report
     --show-missing --include="*/verify.py"` — confirm line 989 is executed
     by the net; save full output as `coverage-rerun.txt`.
8. Emit the manifest update (edit ONLY these fields of run-dir
   `manifest.json`): `head_sha`=HEAD_TEST (40-hex); `negative_control` :=
   {did: same text, tool: "hand", result: the ACTUAL rerun RED line
   (failures/errors counts + AssertionError present), artifact:
   ".../negctrl-rerun.txt", command: unchanged}; `binding_audit` :=
   {coverage: "PF-2 (1/1)", method: "criterion quoted, covering tests quoted,
   criterion-violating mutation went RED (4/4 mutants killed across the
   kind-gate expression; m1 RED carries the bogus-case AssertionError plus a
   behavior-demonstrating AttributeError on the non-dict case)"}; append to
   `artifacts[]` sha256 pins for the NINE new files (tests-rerun.txt,
   negctrl-rerun.txt, audit-m1-rerun.diff, audit-rerun-clean.txt,
   audit-rerun-m1-red.txt, audit-rerun-reverted.txt, audit-rerun-m2-red.txt,
   audit-rerun-m3-red.txt, audit-rerun-m4-red.txt, coverage-rerun.txt — ten);
   `toolchain` += "; builder <your agent id + model> via Orca (wave 2)";
   `claim` := "PF-2 characterized by OracleScopeKindTest (4 tests), pinned
   hand mutant m1 KILLED with supporting mutants m2/m3/m4 KILLED (wave-2
   re-execution), build-blind review pending." Validate JSON parses.
9. Commit 2 (evidence only): `prove-it rerun: re-executed PF-2 audit evidence
   (issue #410)` — the ten new run-dir files + `manifest.json`, nothing else.
10. Push: `git fetch origin`; verify fast-forward (`git merge-base
    --is-ancestor origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo HEAD`); push the unit
    branch to the PR branch WITHOUT force:
    `git push origin prove-it-pf2-rerun-wt:roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo`;
    verify with `git ls-remote origin roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo`. If the
    FF check fails, STOP and `ask` (never force-push). Also verify the
    binding record: the `tests rerun` commands[] entry's wtree equals
    HEAD_TEST's tree, and HEAD_TEST is now on origin.
11. Update the Orca worktree comment with your checkpoint status, then
    `worker_done --outcome succeeded --report-path
    docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/manifest.json --files-modified
    tests/test_verify.py[,…run-dir files…]` with a three-sentence summary
    naming HEAD_TEST, the RED signature, and the push verification. On ANY
    STOP above: `worker_done --outcome failed` naming the blocker instead —
    never fake a green.

## Observable acceptance
`OracleScopeKindTest` runs 4 tests OK on the clean tree; m1 RED shows
failures>=1 with AssertionError; m2/m3/m4 RED; production file byte-identical
after revert; two new commits by the maintainer author on
origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo; manifest parses with head_sha=HEAD_TEST
and a `tests rerun` exit-0 record whose wtree is HEAD_TEST's tree.

# prove-it PF-2 rerun — BLIND REVIEWER task spec (wave 2, orchestrated)

You are a supervised Orca worker. Obey the live preamble injected with this task
for all lifecycle mechanics (`check`, `ask`, `worker_done`). In particular: run
`orca orchestration check --terminal <your_handle>` at each checkpoint and once
more immediately before `worker_done`; send `worker_done` exactly once with an
explicit `--outcome succeeded|failed` (omit `--to`); every send carries `--from
<your_handle> --dispatch-capability <capability>` from the preamble.

You are BUILD-BLIND: a fresh session that did not write the code. A different
vendor's agent built it (Anthropic claude); you review it cold.

## Target
Repo orca-fleet, the unit worktree (cwd — same worktree the builder used, fresh
terminal). Frozen criterion: `docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/contract.json`
(PF-2 only). Candidate under review: `tests/test_verify.py::OracleScopeKindTest`
(4 tests) at the builder's test commit HEAD_TEST (see step 1) + the pinned
mutant diff `docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/audit-m1-rerun.diff`.

## Change
A blind acceptance review of the re-executed PF-2 characterization net,
recorded as `docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/review-rerun.txt`
(prompt + reply retained), committed and pushed to the PR branch.

## Constraints
- Blind-fix FIRST (anti-anchoring, acceptance-review.md): BEFORE reading the
  test or the mutant, read ONLY the frozen PF-2 criterion (+ the production
  gate lines `runtime/scripts/verify.py:988-989` for context) and write your
  OWN expectation to the artifact: where the test should live, its rough
  shape, which inputs must be covered (including the non-dict disjunct), and a
  confidence. Only then open the candidate and judge the delta. Divergence is
  signal, not error.
- Methodology pack: matt ONLY — read
  `/Users/ravindra/.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` for method
  (fixed-point discipline, every finding quotes its verbatim motivating line —
  a finding that cannot quote goes to an appendix as unconfirmed, axes
  side-by-side with NO cross-rerank). NEVER load any addy/gstack skill.
- Judge on the mission's THREE axes (spec fidelity / mutant validity /
  tautology guard — defined in step 3), not the skill's default two; the pack
  provides method, the mission provides axes.
- Read-only except the ONE artifact file. NEVER edit tests, production code,
  the manifest, the contract, or any solo-run file. No commits except the
  review artifact commit below. No secrets.
- Git: author `Ravindra Kumar <ravidsrk@gmail.com>`, no trailers, never
  force-push, never open a PR. `reviewed_sha` (step 1) is recorded in the
  artifact; if the reviewed bytes differ from the worktree, STOP and `ask`.

## Ownership
The review artifact + its commit. The coordinator owns manifest/review-field
updates, the verifier re-record, and the report.

## Steps
1. Setup: `git fetch origin`. Resolve HEAD_TEST: the builder's test commit —
   `git log --oneline origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo` and identify
   `prove-it rerun: pin non-dict scope at the PF-2 kind gate (issue #410)`;
   record its full SHA as reviewed_sha. Checkout the unit branch state:
   `git checkout prove-it-pf2-rerun-wt` (create a tracking branch from origin
   if absent) and fast-forward to origin. Verify freshness: `git diff
   <reviewed_sha> -- tests/test_verify.py` MUST be empty (the reviewed test
   bytes are exactly the worktree bytes) — else STOP and `ask`.
2. Blind expectation (criterion + gate lines ONLY — do not open the test yet):
   write Part 1 of `review-rerun.txt`: header (reviewer agent id + model,
   reviewed_sha, timestamp), the PF-2 criterion quoted verbatim, your
   expectation (location, shape, required inputs incl. non-dict, confidence).
3. Open the candidate (the OracleScopeKindTest class in
   `tests/test_verify.py` at `<reviewed_sha>`, plus `audit-m1-rerun.diff`)
   and judge:
   - Axis 1 Spec fidelity: does the net assert EXACTLY what PF-2 says —
     refusal of an illegal kind AT the kind gate (dict-bogus AND non-dict
     cases — quote the test lines carrying each half) and admission of BOTH
     legal kinds PAST the kind gate? Flag any gap (compare against your
     Part-1 expectation; name convergences and divergences).
   - Axis 2 Mutant validity: is m1 behavior-changing yet harness-preserving
     (module still imports, suite still collects)? Trace the bogus case under
     m1 (which gate does it reach, what error returns, FAIL with
     AssertionError?) and the non-dict case (AttributeError ERROR — is that a
     behavior-demonstrating RED or a stillborn-shaped one? judge plainly).
     Trace why the two legal-kind cases still pass.
   - Axis 3 Tautology guard: could any assertion pass while PF-2 is broken?
     State plainly whether each assertion binds to the kind gate.
   Every finding quotes its verbatim motivating line (test line, gate line,
   or diff hunk); unquotable material goes to an appendix as unconfirmed.
4. Verdict: GO or NO-GO (one line) + a summary brief UNDER 400 words — the
   findings carry the detail. Round 1 of max 3 (acceptance-review.md budget).
5. Commit the artifact ONLY: `prove-it rerun: blind review of the PF-2 net
   (issue #410)`. Push WITHOUT force: `git fetch origin`, FF-check (`git
   merge-base --is-ancestor origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo HEAD`), `git
   push origin prove-it-pf2-rerun-wt:roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo`, verify
   with `git ls-remote`. FF failure → STOP and `ask`.
6. Update the Orca worktree comment with your checkpoint status, then
   `worker_done --outcome succeeded --report-path
   docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/review-rerun.txt --files-modified
   docs/runs/2026-09-16-prove-it-selfrun/review-rerun.txt` with a
   three-sentence summary naming reviewed_sha, the verdict, and push
   verification. NO-GO verdicts still complete the review task (report them
   with `--outcome succeeded` + the NO-GO in the summary — the verdict is the
   deliverable); infrastructure blockers use `--outcome failed`.

## Observable acceptance
`review-rerun.txt` carries Part 1 (pre-read expectation) + the three-axis
judgment with quoted lines + GO/NO-GO + reviewed_sha; committed by the
maintainer author and pushed to origin/roadmap/issue-410-prove-promo.
